split: Box of 10 Dual-Casings: each combines up to 2 ammo types.
Box of 10 Tri-Casings: each combines up to 3 ammo types.
COMBO CASINGS.rules: Adapter casings that merge different arrows, bullets, shells, or slugs into one round with all of their effects. If any merged type deals no damage, the round deals none, though its other effects still apply. The included jig loads 10 rounds as one Action; by hand it's an Action per round. Casings are single-use. Firing combined rounds treats the weapon as one quality tier lower (Poor Quality weapons are Destroyed, not beyond repair); quality-raising attachments still work from that lower base.

DRONE LURE.rules: Thrown only; not for Grenade Launchers. Hovers over its landing square and for 15 seconds (5 Rounds) broadcasts in a 10x10m/yds (5x5 square) area around itself. Drones not under direct control that start their Turn in the area or move through it must beat DV21 Concentration (using their Combat Number) or prioritize attacking or watching the lure over targets that haven't engaged them since their last Turn. Afterward it drops, Destroyed Beyond Repair.

HOMING ADAPTER KIT.rules: With an Action and 1 minute, turns one non-hovering, non-Smart grenade into a Homing grenade (uses up the kit). Homing grenades can't go in Grenade Launchers. Thrown, it hovers over its landing square and spends the Round scanning a 14x14m/yds (7x7 square) area, through smoke, glass, and darkness but not roofs, for the biggest threat to you, friend or foe. Next Round it flies at that target over any Cover and detonates; dodging it takes DV17 Evasion. While hovering it can be hit with an Aimed Shot, which makes it burst harmlessly.

HVAP AMMUNITION.rules: Bullets that count as Armor-Piercing, High Precision, and High Velocity ammo at once.

IMPROVED EMP AMMUNITION.rules: Works as EMP ammo but still deals damage; it doesn't ablate SP or cause Critical Injuries. Against targets with any SP, damage drops by 1d6 (minimum 2d6), except drones and FBCs.

LASER GRENADE.rules: Thrown only; not for Grenade Launchers. Hovers over its landing square and for 9 seconds (3 Rounds) sweeps a 6x6m/yds (3x3 square) area with lasers. Anyone starting their Turn there or passing through must beat DV17 Evasion or Contortionist or take 4d6, which doesn't ablate armor or harm Cover and ignores armor below SP 12. Its Critical Injuries roll twice and the thrower picks. Afterward it drops, Destroyed Beyond Repair.

OVERPRESSURE AMMUNITION/WARBOW ARROW.name: Overpressure Ammunition / Warbow Arrow
OVERPRESSURE AMMUNITION/WARBOW ARROW.rules: Firing it from a Poor Quality weapon Destroys the weapon (not beyond repair). On a Critical Success (10) on the attack, the exploding d10 is also added to the damage before armor.

RECON GRENADE.rules: Thrown or launched. Scans a 10x10m/yds (5x5 square) area where it lands and sends the data to your Neuroport. Everyone there is marked for 9 seconds (3 Rounds): you see their outlines through cover, smoke, darkness, and other obscurement, and Smart or Improved Smart ammo gets +1 to hit them.

SONIC GRENADE.rules: Deals no damage. Everyone hit must beat DV17 Resist Torture/Drugs or suffer the effects of Concussion and Lost Ear, without their Death Save penalty or Bonus Damage.

STICKY ADAPTER KIT.rules: With an Action and 1 minute, turns one non-hovering damaging grenade into a Sticky grenade (uses up the kit). Targets dodging a Sticky grenade take -2.

SUBSONIC AMMUNITION.rules: Bullets and slugs. Anyone trying to hear a Single Shot fired with it takes -2 to the check.

WALL-PIERCING GRENADE.rules: Only detonates when it hits Cover. Against a single layer of Thin Cover it drills through and explodes on the far side for 6d6 in a 6x6m/yds (3x3 square) area spreading out from the impact, like a shotgun shell. Thick Cover is treated as Thin Cover of the same material (e.g., 25 HP thick concrete becomes 10 HP thin concrete), and only the Cover takes damage; none carries past it. Can't be combined with the Homing or Sticky Adapter Kits.
